neu: "“Chiara's right. The bag goes overboard tonight.”"
"Pushes the bag over to Totò. “Keep it safe, and nobody knows.”"
"Takes Siri's side. “The guests give their shower minutes to the crew.”"
"“Count the minibars and leave the cabins, like Sophia says.”"
"“No stripping and no counting. The guest cabins stay as they are.”"
"Picks up the phone. “I'll call Megan myself.”"
"Takes the envelope. “Everyone plays along in Yasin's video tomorrow.”"
O("Pushes the envelope back. “We are not your props, Yasin.”", [V("chiara", 6), V("yasin", -6), R(3)], von="chiara"),

alt: "Only those who want to take part."
neu: "“Whoever wants to be in the video can be. Nobody has to.”"
"“We'll do the mayor's show. Costumes, song, everything.”"
"“Thank the mayor for us, and tell her no.”"
"“Nobody else has to do it. I'll sing for the mayor, alone.”"
"Gives the night watch to Rosi. “You're Sicilian. Close your eyes angrily up there.”"
"Gives the night watch to Lea. “Stay awake, and wake me if the anchor moves.”"
"Keeps the night watch himself. “Go to bed, both of you.”"
"Goes with Lea and Petru at dawn. “Back by noon, Rosi.”"
"“Nobody goes, Lea. Rosi needs every hand here tomorrow.”"
"“Lea and Totò go with Petru. I stay here.”"
"Nods at Totò. “Take the crates out tonight, and have them back tomorrow evening.”"
"Sides with Chiara. “We declare everything to Elsa.”"
"“Chiara's right. No kids on board, it's too risky.”"
"“Let the kids come for a tour in the afternoon.”"
"“Sophia organises a small breakfast on the foredeck, with no cameras.”"
"Lets Yasin have his way. “Drone, champagne, sponsored cake. Do it.”"
"Nods at Totò's list. “Sell it all. We have to eat.”"
"Hands the list back to Totò. “No. That's stealing from the Group.”"

alt: "Only the champagne, and only to Alva."
neu: "“Sell the champagne, but only to Alva. The rest stays on board.”"
"“All right, Rosi. You cook tomorrow.”"
"Sides with Sophia. “We order from Alva, and nobody gets poisoned.”"
"Takes the apron off Rosi. “I'll cook tomorrow.”"
"“Leave the nest. Kevin can stay on panel four.”"
"“The nest goes, and so does Kevin. Sorry, Lea.”"
"Takes Siri's side. “No phones and no cameras tomorrow night. That means you, Yasin.”"
"“Chiara's right. Guests in the salon, crew in the mess.”"
"Sides with Lola. “One table for everyone, guests and crew.”"
"“Chiara's right. We polish the whole boat tonight, every handle and every glass.”"
"“Make your sign, Rosi. Let Megan see the truth.”"
"“We polish the salon and nothing else.”"
"Shrugs at Chiara. “Nothing happened, really. Two people went for a swim.”"
"“Chiara gets her rule. From now on, swimwear only.”"
"“All right, Rosi. One more day, then you sleep.”"
"“You take tomorrow off, Rosi. That's an order.”"
"Sides with Rosi. “We pay Petru in euros for the fish.”"
"“Lea and I will mend his nets tomorrow.”"
"“Send Totò to Petru instead, with a bottle of wine.”"
"“Give Siri the crew bunk, Sophia. That's my decision, Yasin.”"

alt: "Let the two of them sort it out."
neu: "Stays out of it. “You two sort this out yourselves.”"
"“It's Siri's choice. If she moves, the crew helps her.”"

alt: "Give it back; Duc talks to Yasin."
neu: "Takes the envelope from Lea. “I'll give it back and talk to Yasin.”"
"“Totò's right, Lea. Put it in the crew box.”"
"“Tell the mayor yes. I'll wear the crown.”"
O("Sides with Chiara. “No shell crown for me. Thank the mayor kindly.”", [V("chiara", 6), V("casanova", -6)], von="chiara"),

alt: "The dinner, the way Megan wants it."
neu: "Nods to Megan. “Eight courses and candles, as you want it. The crew will serve.”"
O("Looks at Megan. “No dinner. This crew is exhausted.”", [V("chiara", 6), V("megan", -8), R(5)], von="chiara"),
"Sides with Lola. “We dance tonight, and that means everyone.”"
"“Chiara's right. Everyone in their bunk by midnight.”"

alt: "Party until midnight, then Duc sends everyone to bed."
neu: "“We dance until midnight, then I send everyone to bed.”"
"“Rosi's right. Cold tins tomorrow, and we save the power.”"
"Sides with Sophia. “One proper meal. I'll cook it.”"
"Gives the long call to Lola. “Ring your Nan. Jana, you'll have to keep yours short.”"
"“Take the long call, Jana, your mama has questions. Lola, keep yours short.”"
"“Take the tender, Jana. Alone, to the harbour and back.”"
"Sides with Chiara. “Not yet, Jana. Six weeks is too short.”"
"Puts Lola's thermos of hot coffee on top of the parcel."
"Puts Chiara's watch lists on top of the parcel. “She'll want to sign them.”"
"“Bake the fish pie, Lola. Petru should eat sitting down for once.”"
"Sides with Chiara. “Not his wife's pie, Lola. Cook him something else.”"
"Signs the form for Totò. “One table, on market day.”"
"Pushes the form back. “Not under the yacht's name, Totò.”"
"“Jana can carry what she likes, Chiara. It's her choice.”"
"“Chiara's right, Jana. Crew is crew, so no more towels for Siri.”"
"Puts his thịt kho up against her pâté."
"Puts both dishes on one plate, half Corsican and half Vietnamese."
"Cooks his best dish, and cooks to win."
"Sets his thịt kho down next to Totò's ragù. “Forks ready, Rosi.”"
"Stands up and reads a cheeky, warm poem about the fridge."
"Reads a poem about the fridge that only Sophia will understand."
"Speaks as the fridge, in the fridge's own voice."
"Races Rosi against the stopwatch to fix the blender."

alt: "Works on it together, one hand each."
neu: "Fixes the blender with Rosi, her right hand and his left."
"Builds his speargun as fast as he can and shoots at the buoy."

alt: "Helps her with the last part so you finish together."
neu: "Helps Chiara with the last part so they finish together."
"Guesses as badly as he can, on purpose. “A seagull?”"
"Turns to the railing. “Petru, you know this sea. Your turn.”"
"Rings the bell. “Phone under the table, Totò. You're disqualified.”"

alt: "A bonus question only you can answer."
neu: "“Bonus question, and only the host knows the answer.”"
"Holds out the second microphone and picks a partner."
"Takes the microphone alone and gives it everything."
"“Chiara's right, Rosi. The interior crew is hers to assign.”"
"“Rosi needs those hands more, Chiara. The repairs come first.”"
"“You two make a plan together, right here, right now.”"
"Gives the cabin to Sophia. “You need the quiet to write.”"
"“The cabin is Lola's. We all need a door between us and that snoring.”"

alt: "They draw lots. Duc holds the hat."
neu: "Holds out his hat. “You two draw lots.”"

alt: "Lea: keep him, just for a bit."
neu: "Sides with Lea. “He can stay in the ice bucket, just for today.”"
"Sides with Siri. “He goes back in the sea, Lea.”"
"Raises Lola's hand. “Lola's arancini win.”"
"“Alva wins. You can taste forty years of this bar.”"
"“Chiara's right. White shirts and navy trousers for everyone.”"
"Sides with Sophia. “Let them shine. Everyone wears what they like.”"
"Takes Chiara's list. “Tins. We stay on budget.”"
"Takes Lola's two pages. “Buy all of it, saffron too.”"
"Sniffs the air. “That's diesel, Alva.”"
"Leans on the bar. “Nice perfume, Alva. Very exclusive.”"
"Nods at the hammer. “Go on, Petru. Let's hear what the engine says.”"
"“Put the hammer down, Petru. Rosi reads the fault code.”"
"Takes the keys and reverses the tender in, calm and slow."
"“Rosi's right, Siri. Cold water it is.”"
"“Totò's right, Lola. No pineapple on his dough.”"
"“Bake two pizzas, one each, and let a jury decide.”"
Then her thumb stops halfway.
